d:
Ranchi: Irfan Ansari ke bayan par jharkhand men siyasi charcha, JMM aur BJP ne sunie kya kaha? |Sonia Gandhi
Jharkhand ke svasthy mantri irphan ansari ke bayan ko lekar rajy ki rajniti men halchal tej ho gaee hai. is bayan ke bad JMM aur BJP ke netaon ki or se alag-alag pratikriyaen samne aaee hain. aakhir irphan ansari ne kya kaha? unke bayan par JMM aur BJP ne kya pratikriya di?
